features.title: First recorded prediction from live prices and memory, resolved by code
criteria: Prices are stored every 5 minutes and survive a process restart
No prediction can be recorded when the asset's latest price is older than 15 minutes
A prediction cannot be recorded without probability, condition, horizon and hypothesis link
A recorded prediction cannot be updated or deleted through the agent's tools
At its horizon, code resolves the prediction from stored prices and computes its Brier score
Resolution appends one evidence row to the linked hypothesis and updates its computed confidence
/statut shows open and resolved predictions in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

implementation.note: src/trader: config, schema with append-only triggers, Kraken collector, hypotheses with computed confidence, record_prediction and sonni_memory tools, resolver, French status, /idee; wired into index, loop, prompt, guard, Telegram

features.title: Sonni already knows things: prior hypotheses tested by code on daily history
criteria: Daily candles for followed assets are fetched from Kraken, skip the unfinished day, survive a restart and are refreshed in place
A hypothesis can carry a test rule; invalid rules are refused with a message the model can act on
Code evaluates each rule on stored history and records cases, hits, rate, base rate, z and verdict, append-only
Historical tests rerun only when new days of data arrive, and never change forward confidence
propose_hypothesis tests a rule at once and returns the verdict; origin is prior during the intake, observation after, with a daily limit
Once history is stored, the intake runs on the stronger model, counts an attempt only on a paid turn, and stops at 30 prior hypotheses or 3 attempts
The memory pack and /intuitions show historical verdicts next to forward evidence, in French for the owner
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

implementation.note: src/trader: candles, rules, historical, intake; propose_hypothesis tool; loop and index hooks; pack and status

features.title: Sonni sees the world: event calendar, headlines and event reactions
criteria: FOMC decision days are read from the Fed calendar page without notation votes; CPI and jobs dates come from FRED only with a key that never appears in errors
Headlines are fetched hourly from GDELT, deduplicated by URL, cleaned, stored with their publication time and purged after 30 days; a plain-text rate-limit answer is reported as an error
Test rules accept event conditions; code evaluates them with the stored calendar and re-tests them when the calendar changes
The memory pack shows upcoming events, reactions to past events computed by code, and recent headlines marked as untrusted data
/agenda and /statut show upcoming events in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

features.title: Sonni knows itself: versioned identity, append-only journal, lessons with evidence, self-report computed by code
criteria: The identity starts from a code-written seed; the model may revise it at most once per UTC day, keeping the anchor words; every version is kept and the owner can read them
A post-mortem can only be written for a scored prediction, once; reflections are append-only and capped per day
A lesson needs at least one existing prediction or hypothesis as evidence, is capped per day and in number, and is retired (never deleted) by the model or by the owner's /veto
The self-report (calibration buckets, Brier by asset, horizon and direction, counts, spend) is computed by code and shown in the memory pack and /bilan
After a prediction resolves, the next wake carries the reflection instructions and code marks the reflection done once a paid turn ran
Identity and active lessons sit in the cached part of the system prompt; the rules block with the day's counters is the last, volatile part
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

features.title: Sonni is curious: code-evaluated triggers and model-set watches wake it from sleep within owner caps
criteria: A move of moveAlertPct within an hour, an event day morning, the morning after an event, resolved predictions, or a fired watch produce a trigger; triggers are logged delivered or not
At most one wake per tick, at most maxSelfWakesPerDay delivered per UTC day, spaced by minMinutesBetweenWakes, and only while sleeping, unpaused and not on a budget cap
The model's watches (price level, move over a window, date) are validated, fire once, cannot fire at once, and their conditions cannot be edited
Sonni's own wake events end a Money Lab sleep (fixing the ignored intake wake) and the wake reason reaches the model
The memory pack lists what happened since the last session and /reveils shows the wakes in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

features.title: Sonni uses free reader models for reading, never for deciding: headlines and pages become validated observations
criteria: Readers are OpenAI-compatible endpoints configured with a key environment variable sealed at startup; a reader without a key is skipped and the key never appears in errors or logs
Calls are counted per reader and per UTC day against the configured cap; a failing reader rests and the next one is tried

Every digest item is validated (index, assets, kind, sentiment range, summary length, prompt-boundary patterns) and stored as an untrusted observation; headlines are marked digested only when a reader answered

read_page accepts only https public hosts (private and link-local addresses, redirects into them and the runtime's own hosts refused), caps bytes and characters, is limited per day, and returns untrusted data
The memory pack shows observations per asset with code-averaged sentiment; /lecteurs shows reader status in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

features.title: Sonni finds its own tools: a catalog of free data sources it enables, sources it proposes to the owner, and the assets it chooses
criteria: The catalog is loaded once with safe defaults enabled; the model enables or disables a source with a logged reason and may propose a keyless public endpoint that waits for the owner's /source ok or non

Sources are polled by code on their own cadence; metrics are extracted by JSON path, keys are substituted without leaking, failures are counted and a source is disabled after MAX_FAILURES with the owner told

A followed asset must be a Kraken EUR pair checked against the public pair list; changes are logged with reasons, at least one asset stays, an asset with open predictions cannot be dropped, and every tick, tool, status and pack uses the live universe
The memory pack shows the latest source values with 24 h and 7 d references; /sources and /actifs answer in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls
